title: OWNER_PHASE_APPROVAL v2 -- the EXECUTABLE Gate 1B EXECUTION approval
description: v2 (owner audit 2026-08-31 sections 1-3). The signature must bind the ACTUAL program: the exact code commit, the frozen artifact tree, the resolved model/container/dependency identities, the data and control manifests, the status program, the protected derivation, and the budget. NOTHING is deferred past the owner's signature. tools/verify_phase_approval.py is the executable form of this schema: it validates every field, verifies the Ed25519 signature against the SEPARATELY pinned public key, requires package_commit_sha to equal the exact checked-out commit, requires the signed artifact-digest key set to equal PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json's key set exactly, recomputes every digest from the tree, and refuses missing, extra, modified, or untracked files. Canonical signing bytes: UTF-8 of json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(',', ':')) with ed25519_signature set to the empty string. A prior CONTAINER_PREP approval (OWNER_CONTAINER_PREP_APPROVAL.schema.json) authorizes resolving the model/container identities; THIS record then binds them.

package_commit_sha.description: the commit containing the FROZEN Gate 1A.1 package AND the complete execution code; the verifier requires equality with the exact checked-out commit

execution_code_commit_sha.description: must EQUAL package_commit_sha (one commit binds docs and code); present as its own field so the binding is explicit in the signed bytes

package_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json itself (the manifest cannot list itself)

gate1b_code_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of GATE1B_CODE_MANIFEST.json (all executable source hashes)

artifact_digests.description: sha256 per frozen artifact path; the key set MUST equal PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json's sha256 map exactly and the verifier recomputes every entry from the tree

model_revision_sha.description: the RESOLVED HuggingFace revision of Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, recorded at container build under the CONTAINER_PREP approval

model_weight_sha256s.description: sha256 of EVERY model weight file, {filename: sha256}

dependency_lock_sha256.description: sha256 of the pip-freeze/lock file baked into the container

dataset_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of DATASET_MANIFEST_CANDIDATE.json (carries the pre-registered protected content digest)

s7_control_table_sha256.description: sha256 of the constructed alternative-taxonomy table (derived/alternative_taxonomy_table.json, built under the CONTAINER_PREP approval); the launcher re-verifies on-instance before any training

status_program_sha256.description: sha256 of tools/emit_gate1_status.py -- the only claim-status authority

protected_derivation_commitment.description: PUBLIC_SEED_20260831 (integrity-only, publicly reconstructible -- never called secret) or SALT_SHA256:<sha256 of the owner-held salt hex> (commit-and-reveal: salt supplied only at the protected step, revealed after the sealed campaign)

owner_ed25519_public_key_hex.description: the owner's Ed25519 PUBLIC key. Pinning law: also committed by the owner in a separate key-pinning commit; the verifier refuses if the in-record key differs from the separately pinned one

signed_utc.description: ISO-8601 with explicit timezone; the verifier parses and rejects invalid or timezone-less values
